scenario_description:
Objective: Keep tomorrow’s plumbing pressure-cycling from turning a borderline under-sink condition into an unattended water problem.
Emerging Need: A daylong absence and routine stack notice are not enough on their own, but later cabinet sensor readings make the planned cycling more concerning.
Decision Context: Stored plumbing notes define which humidity pattern matters, distinguish a preventive shutoff from emergency repair, and tie it to staffed-entry limits.
Consequence: After same-day intake closes, no leak or damage is documented, but the unit loses the practical route for a preventive in-cabinet check before cycling begins.

parameter.content: Reminder for stacks 1101-1308: domestic-water pressure cycling is scheduled Sunday 9:00 AM-1:00 PM. No resident action is required for normal fixtures, but please monitor any in-unit supply concerns after service.

parameter.name: Loring House Saturday Entry Desk
parameter.notes: Rostered same-day intake contact for signed limited-entry authorizations; Sunday service-related requests close Saturday at 5:00 PM.

parameter.content: Under-sink cabinet trend notice: 74% relative humidity at 2:15 PM and 77% at 2:20 PM. Moisture contacts remain dry; no standing-water alarm has triggered.

parameter.subject: Sunday pressure-cycling limited-entry intake closed
parameter.body: The staffed-entry list for non-emergency Sunday pressure-cycling checks is now closed. After-hours staff can take active leak calls only; new preventive cabinet checks or supply shutoff authorizations will not be added before tomorrow morning's cycling window.
